diagnose.instructions: Read the task description. Use the platform API to check service status and read logs. Identify the root cause. Do NOT modify anything. API actions allowed: list_services, get_service, get_logs, get_volume, list_volumes.

investigate.instructions: Investigate the root cause further. Check environment variables, test connections. API actions allowed: get_env, test_connection, get_logs. Still read-only — do NOT modify anything.

propose_fix.instructions: Propose the fix. Describe exactly what you will change and why. Do NOT execute the fix yet. Write your proposal as text output.

approve_fix.instructions: The proposed fix requires human approval before execution.

APPROVED.approval_message: Review the proposed fix before allowing execution.

execute_fix.instructions: Execute the approved fix. API actions allowed: update_env, restart_service. Do NOT use delete_volume or delete_service.

verify.instructions: Verify the fix worked. Test the connection, check service status, review logs. API actions allowed: test_connection, get_service, get_logs.
